question: The diagnosis of sarcoidosis is based on:

options.opa: Clinical-radiological compatible picture and presence of non-caseating granulomas in one or more organs, with negative cultures of mycobacteria and fungi.
options.opb: Elevation of the serum level of the angiotensin conversion enzyme in a patient with a compatible clinical-radiological picture.
options.opc: Characteristic radiological findings in high-resolution computed tomography of the chest in a patient with clinical suspicion.
options.opd: Presence of lymphocytic alveolitis with predominance of CD4 + lymphocytes in bronchoalveolar lavage in a patient with a compatible clinical-radiological picture.
options.ope: Finding of granulomatous cellularity in a fine needle aspiration puncture (FNAP) of an affected organ in a patient with a compatible clinical-radiological picture.
